attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd 3.6.10 cluster (node1, node2, node3) on Alpine Linux using apk-provided etcd/etcd-ctl packages and OpenRC. Configured each node's /etc/etcd/conf.yml with peer/client URLs bound to its NODE_IP and a shared initial-cluster list, then started the etcd service on all three. Verified cross-member replication, verified reads/writes continue with one member down (quorum preserved), and verified the downed member catches up on rejoin. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol for all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full etcd health/data/quorum recovery after each.
